items.text: Hello Builders,
It's here, the Foundations expansion is OUT! Explore and restore 2 new maps, featuring new mechanics and for the first time in Roadcraft: Pile Driving!
This DLC comes with some quality of life fixes, general performance improvements, as well as UI changes (you can now enable a minimalistic UI).
As a reminder, this expansion is not included in the Year 1 pass.

🚧 Hello Builders!
We're releasing Patch 7.4 addressing a major topic: performance.
This patch fixes a bunch of performance drops and improves overall game stability.
Thank you for your continous feedback on this topic and see you soon for the Foundations Expansion!
Hello Builders,

We're just deploying a quick hotfix to revert the change made to sand quarries in patch 7.2. Sand quarries are now unlocked again after re-entering maps. We apologize for the inconvenience caused by the initial change.

Patch 7.2 is out with multiple fixes and improvements across the board. We've adressed the issue of roads disappearing for clients after joining public games and desync issues on largely terraformed maps.
We've also made multiple improvements to Road Planning and the AI using it.
Full Patch Notes below.

Updated VFX for certain buildings
Corrected logo color display on several vehicles

🚧 Hello Builders!
Vehicle mod editor is now available in Roadcraft! Start importing your 3D mods and play with them, and share them with other players.
Alongside this new feature, we have a bunch of vehicle, bug & progression fixes. Full patch notes are just below!

We just deployed a hotfix that brings stability improvements, and fixes the issue with corrupted files when leaving mid-session by doing Alt+F4.
General Fixes
Fixed the most frequent crashes affecting players.
With these fixes we’re making a step forward for a more stable game. We’re far from done on this subject, and stability improvements will remain a priority.

Today we’re pushing our first update for RoadCraft. It brings various bug fixes, improves AI convoys, removes the profanity filter on PC on top of other quality of life improvements.
Profanity filter when creating a company has been disabled on PC.
We noted that the profanity filter was much too restrictive when creating a company name. Don’t use this as an excuse to create a company with an offensive name!
Added a new popup when attempting to activate multiplayer when Privacy Policy was not accepted.

We've noticed that many players have concerns about data collection for multiplayer services. Please be assured that we do not collect any non-obfuscated personal player data and are in full compliance with GDPR and other personal data protection laws. If you choose not to share any technical data, we understand, but unfortunately, providing multiplayer functionality becomes technically impossible in that case.
